title: Invoke cross account AWS Lambda function directly via AWS Step Functions
description: Create a Step Functions workflow which invokes cross account Lambda function

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This sample pattern allows users from one account to invoke their Lambda function present in a different account via Step Functions and retrieve the desired output.
This is highly efficient and useful when it comes to pulling cross account data all in one place.
